    [31mfunction drawSlashArc(fromQ, fromR, toQ, toR, power, progress) {[39m
    [31m  const [fx, fy] = hexCenter(fromQ, fromR);[39m
    [31m  const [tx, ty] = hexCenter(toQ, toR);[39m
    [31m  const midX = (fx + tx) / 2, midY = (fy + ty) / 2;[39m
    [31m  const dx = tx - fx, dy = ty - fy;[39m
    [31m  const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);[39m
    [31m  const perpX = -dy / (dist || 1), perpY = dx / (dist || 1);[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  const alpha = progress < 0.5 ? progress * 2 : (1 - progress) * 2;[39m
    [31m  const arcSize = 20 + power / 20;[39m
    [31m  const thickness = 3 + power / 100;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  ctx.save();[39m
    [31m  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Outer glow[39m
    [31m  ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m  ctx.moveTo(fx, fy);[39m
    [31m  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(midX + perpX * arcSize, midY + perpY * arcSize, tx, ty);[39m
    [31m  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';[39m
    [31m  ctx.lineWidth = thickness + 6;[39m
    [31m  ctx.lineCap = 'round';[39m
    [31m  ctx.stroke();[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Inner bright arc[39m
    [31m  ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m  ctx.moveTo(fx, fy);[39m
    [31m  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(midX + perpX * arcSize * 0.7, midY + perpY * arcSize * 0.7, tx, ty);[39m
    [31m  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,220,150,0.9)';[39m
    [31m  ctx.lineWidth = thickness;[39m
    [31m  ctx.stroke();[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Core white arc[39m
    [31m  ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m  ctx.moveTo(fx, fy);[39m
    [31m  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(midX + perpX * arcSize * 0.5, midY + perpY * arcSize * 0.5, tx, ty);[39m
    [31m  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,1)';[39m
    [31m  ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, thickness - 1);[39m
    [31m  ctx.stroke();[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  ctx.restore();[39m
    [31m}[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31mfunction drawImpactEffect(q, r, power, isMelee, age) {[39m
    [31m  const [cx, cy] = hexCenter(q, r);[39m
    [31m  const alpha = 1 - age;[39m
    [31m  if (alpha <= 0) return;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  const baseRadius = 10 + power / 30;[39m
    [31m  const ringCount = isMelee ? 2 : 1;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  ctx.save();[39m
    [31m  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  for (let i = 0; i < ringCount; i++) {[39m
    [31m    const r1 = baseRadius + age * 35 + i * 8;[39m
    [31m    const r2 = baseRadius + age * 20 + i * 5;[39m
    [31m    if (r1 < 50) {[39m
    [31m      // Expanding shock ring[39m
    [31m      ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m      ctx.arc(cx, cy, r1, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m      ctx.strokeStyle = isMelee ? 'rgba(255,200,100,0.7)' : 'rgba(255,150,80,0.6)';[39m
    [31m      ctx.lineWidth = 3 - age * 2;[39m
    [31m      ctx.stroke();[39m
    [31m    }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m    // Inner filled circle[39m
    [31m    ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m    ctx.arc(cx, cy, r2, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, r2);[39m
    [31m    g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)');[39m
    [31m    g.addColorStop(0.3, isMelee ? 'rgba(255,220,120,0.5)' : 'rgba(255,180,60,0.4)');[39m
    [31m    g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,100,30,0)');[39m
    [31m    ctx.fillStyle = g;[39m
    [31m    ctx.fill();[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Spark particles[39m
    [31m  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {[39m
    [31m    const angle = (i / 6) * Math.PI * 2 + age * 2;[39m
    [31m    const dist = age * 30 + 5;[39m
    [31m    const sx = cx + Math.cos(angle) * dist;[39m
    [31m    const sy = cy + Math.sin(angle) * dist;[39m
    [31m    const sparkSize = 2 - age * 1.5;[39m
    [31m    if (sparkSize > 0.3) {[39m
    [31m      ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m      ctx.arc(sx, sy, sparkSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,240,200,${alpha})`;[39m
    [31m      ctx.fill();[39m
    [31m    }[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  ctx.restore();[39m
    [31m}[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31mfunction drawProjectileTrail(projId, pos, animStep, keyframes) {[39m
    [31m  if (animStep < 1) return;[39m
    [31m  const projKfs = keyframes.filter(k => k.projectileId === projId).sort((a, b) => a.step - b.step);[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  for (let i = 1; i <= Math.min(3, animStep); i++) {[39m
    [31m    const kfIdx = animStep - i;[39m
    [31m    let trailQ, trailR;[39m
    [31m    if (kfIdx >= 0 && kfIdx < projKfs.length) {[39m
    [31m      trailQ = projKfs[kfIdx].q;[39m
    [31m      trailR = projKfs[kfIdx].r;[39m
    [31m    } else if (pos.prevQ !== undefined) {[39m
    [31m      trailQ = pos.prevQ; trailR = pos.prevR;[39m
    [31m    } else continue;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m    const [cx, cy] = hexCenter(trailQ, trailR);[39m
    [31m    const alpha = (3 - i) / 3 * 0.4;[39m
    [31m    const size = 3 + i;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m    ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m    ctx.arc(cx, cy, size, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,200,100,${alpha})`;[39m
    [31m    ctx.fill();[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m}[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31mfunction drawGatherEffect(q, r, color, amount, progress) {[39m
    [31m  const [cx, cy] = hexCenter(q, r);[39m
    [31m  // Longer peak: alpha stays high for middle 60% of animation[39m
    [31m  const peak = 1 - Math.abs(progress - 0.5) * 1.4;[39m
    [31m  const alpha = Math.max(0, peak);[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  ctx.save();[39m
    [31m  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha * 0.85;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Pulsing rings (2 rings at different phases)[39m
    [31m  for (let ring = 0; ring < 2; ring++) {[39m
    [31m    const rp = (progress + ring * 0.3) % 1;[39m
    [31m    const radius = 16 + rp * 28;[39m
    [31m    ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m    ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m    ctx.strokeStyle = color;[39m
    [31m    ctx.lineWidth = 3 - rp * 2;[39m
    [31m    ctx.stroke();[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Inner bright glow[39m
    [31m  const glowR = 12 + Math.sin(progress * Math.PI) * 10;[39m
    [31m  ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m  ctx.arc(cx, cy, glowR, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, glowR);[39m
    [31m  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)');[39m
    [31m  g.addColorStop(0.3, color);[39m
    [31m  g.addColorStop(1, 'transparent');[39m
    [31m  ctx.fillStyle = g;[39m
    [31m  ctx.fill();[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Particles spiraling upward (8 particles)[39m
    [31m  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {[39m
    [31m    const baseAngle = (i / 8) * Math.PI * 2;[39m
    [31m    const angle = baseAngle + progress * 4;[39m
    [31m    const dist = 10 + progress * 28;[39m
    [31m    const px = cx + Math.cos(angle) * dist;[39m
    [31m    const py = cy + Math.sin(angle) * dist * 0.6 - progress * 26;[39m
    [31m    const pSize = 3.5 - progress * 1.5;[39m
    [31m    if (pSize > 0.5) {[39m
    [31m      ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m      ctx.arc(px, py, pSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m      ctx.fillStyle = i % 2 === 0 ? '#ffffff' : color;[39m
    [31m      ctx.fill();[39m
    [31m    }[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Amount text floating up[39m
    [31m  if (amount > 0 && progress < 0.8) {[39m
    [31m    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${1 - progress})`;[39m
    [31m    ctx.font = 'bold 14px \"KaiTi\",serif';[39m
    [31m    ctx.textAlign = 'center';[39m
    [31m    ctx.fillText(`+${amount}`, cx, cy - 30 - progress * 24);[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  ctx.restore();[39m
    [31m}[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31mfunction drawDashTrail(fromQ, fromR, toQ, toR, progress) {[39m
    [31m  const [fx, fy] = hexCenter(fromQ, fromR);[39m
    [31m  const [tx, ty] = hexCenter(toQ, toR);[39m
    [31m  const dx = tx - fx, dy = ty - fy;[39m
    [31m  const perpX = -dy * 0.3, perpY = dx * 0.3;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  ctx.save();[39m
    [31m  const alpha = 0.7 - progress * 0.5;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Speed lines along dash path[39m
    [31m  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {[39m
    [31m    const t = (i / 4) + progress * 0.3;[39m
    [31m    if (t > 1) continue;[39m
    [31m    const lx = fx + dx * Math.max(0, t - 0.2);[39m
    [31m    const ly = fy + dy * Math.max(0, t - 0.2);[39m
    [31m    const rx = fx + dx * Math.min(1, t + 0.1);[39m
    [31m    const ry = fy + dy * Math.min(1, t + 0.1);[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m    ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m    ctx.moveTo(lx + perpX, ly + perpY);[39m
    [31m    ctx.lineTo(rx + perpX, ry + perpY);[39m
    [31m    ctx.moveTo(lx - perpX, ly - perpY);[39m
    [31m    ctx.lineTo(rx - perpX, ry - perpY);[39m
    [31m    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha * 0.5})`;[39m
    [31m    ctx.lineWidth = 2;[39m
    [31m    ctx.stroke();[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Ghost afterimages[39m
    [31m  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {[39m
    [31m    const t = progress - (i + 1) * 0.15;[39m
    [31m    if (t < 0) continue;[39m
    [31m    const gx = fx + dx * t;[39m
    [31m    const gy = fy + dy * t;[39m
    [31m    ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m    ctx.arc(gx, gy, 18, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.15 - i * 0.04})`;[39m
    [31m    ctx.fill();[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  ctx.restore();[39m
    [31m}[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31mfunction drawTeleportEffect(fromQ, fromR, toQ, toR, progress) {[39m
    [31m  const [fx, fy] = hexCenter(fromQ, fromR);[39m
    [31m  const [tx, ty] = hexCenter(toQ, toR);[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  ctx.save();[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Origin flash (fading out)[39m
    [31m  const outAlpha = (1 - progress) * 0.8;[39m
    [31m  if (outAlpha > 0) {[39m
    [31m    ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m    ctx.arc(fx, fy, 22 + progress * 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(139,92,246,${outAlpha * 0.3})`;[39m
    [31m    ctx.fill();[39m
    [31m    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${outAlpha})`;[39m
    [31m    ctx.lineWidth = 3;[39m
    [31m    ctx.stroke();[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Destination flash (fading in)[39m
    [31m  const inAlpha = progress * 0.8;[39m
    [31m  if (inAlpha > 0) {[39m
    [31m    ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m    ctx.arc(tx, ty, 22 + (1 - progress) * 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(139,92,246,${inAlpha * 0.3})`;[39m
    [31m    ctx.fill();[39m
    [31m    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${inAlpha})`;[39m
    [31m    ctx.lineWidth = 3;[39m
    [31m    ctx.stroke();[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m    // Inner bright core[39m
    [31m    ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m    ctx.arc(tx, ty, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${inAlpha * 0.9})`;[39m
    [31m    ctx.fill();[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  ctx.restore();[39m
    [31m}[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31mfunction drawWalkTrail(fromQ, fromR, toQ, toR, progress) {[39m
    [31m  const [fx, fy] = hexCenter(fromQ, fromR);[39m
    [31m  const [tx, ty] = hexCenter(toQ, toR);[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  ctx.save();[39m
    [31m  // Simple dust puffs along the path[39m
    [31m  for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {[39m
    [31m    const t = progress - i * 0.3;[39m
    [31m    if (t < 0 || t > 1) continue;[39m
    [31m    const px = fx + (tx - fx) * t;[39m
    [31m    const py = fy + (ty - fy) * t;[39m
    [31m    const alpha = (1 - i * 0.3) * 0.4 * (1 - progress);[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m    ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m    ctx.arc(px + (i - 0.5) * 8, py + 12, 4 + progress * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(200,190,180,${alpha})`;[39m
    [31m    ctx.fill();[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m  ctx.restore();[39m
    [31m}[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31mfunction drawGrappleLine(fromQ, fromR, toQ, toR, progress) {[39m
    [31m  const [fx, fy] = hexCenter(fromQ, fromR);[39m
    [31m  const [tx, ty] = hexCenter(toQ, toR);[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  ctx.save();[39m
    [31m  // Rope/chain line[39m
    [31m  ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m  ctx.moveTo(fx, fy);[39m
    [31m  ctx.lineTo(tx, ty);[39m
    [31m  ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(180,160,140,0.6)`;[39m
    [31m  ctx.lineWidth = 2;[39m
    [31m  ctx.setLineDash([4, 3]);[39m
    [31m  ctx.stroke();[39m
    [31m  ctx.setLineDash([]);[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Hook head at destination[39m
    [31m  const hookAlpha = progress > 0.5 ? 1 : progress * 2;[39m
    [31m  ctx.beginPath();[39m

    [31mfunction shiftRole(delta) {[39m
    [31m  const cfg = activeConfig();[39m

    [31m  const gameoverShown = document.getElementById('gameover-panel').classList.contains('show');[39m
    [31m  // Premature rematch: our game still running, opponent's game ended first.[39m
    [31m  if (!gameoverShown && battleSession.battleActive) {[39m
    [31m    pendingRemoteRematchClass = remoteClass;[39m
    [31m    return;[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m  remoteClassPick = remoteClass;[39m
    [31m  if (seed) battleSeed = seed;[39m
    [31m  // Opponent clicked first while we're in game-over screen — show indicator[39m
    [31m  if (gameoverShown && !pendingMyClass) {[39m
    [31m    opponentReadyForRematch = true;[39m
    [31m    updateRematchButton();[39m
    [31m    return;[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m  // Both sides have clicked: start the game[39m
    [31m  const myClass = pendingMyClass || document.getElementById('p2p-class-select').value;[39m
    [31m  // If we already clicked (premature sender), re-send our class so the other[39m
    [31m  // side gets a fresh CLASS_PICK while their game-over is showing[39m
    [31m  if (pendingMyClass) {[39m
    [31m    nm.sendClassPick(myClass, battleSeed);[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m  pendingMyClass = null;[39m
    [31m  opponentReadyForRematch = false;[39m
    [31m  tryInitWithClasses(nm, myClass);[39m
    [31m}[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31mfunction tryInitWithClasses(nm, myClass) {[39m
    [31m  if (!remoteClassPick) return;[39m
    [31m  const myId = nm.myPlayerId;[39m
    [31m  const p1Class = myId === 'player1' ? myClass : remoteClassPick;[39m
    [31m  const p2Class = myId === 'player2' ? myClass : remoteClassPick;[39m
    [31m  remoteClassPick = null; // reset for reconnection[39m
    [31m  battleSession.initGame(p1Class, p2Class, battleSeed);[39m
    [31m  battleSeed = 0; // reset for next game[39m
    [31m  document.getElementById('submit-status').textContent = '等待双方提交...';[39m
    [31m  battleSession.startTurnTimeout();[39m
    [31m}[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31mconst handleRemoteAction = (nm, action) => {[39m
    [31m  // Apply opponent's action to our local engine[39m
    [31m  engine.submitAction(action.charId, action.skillId, action.targetPos ?? null);[39m
    [31m  if (battleSession.isRequiredActionReady(action.charId)) battleSession.remoteSubmittedSet.add(action.charId);[39m
    [31m  battleSession.updateSubmitStatus(nm);[39m
    [31m  renderAll();[39m
    [31m};[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31mconst executeP2PTurn = async (nm) => {[39m
    [31m  battleSession.clearTurnTimeout();[39m
    [31m  const result = await engine.executeTurn();[39m
    [31m  if (!result.success) return;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  battleSession.localSubmittedSet.clear();[39m
    [31m  battleSession.remoteSubmittedSet.clear();[39m
    [31m  battleSession.clearPlannedActions();[39m

    [31m  if (result.battleEnded) {[39m
    [31m    renderAll();[39m
    [31m    return;[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  animateTurn().then(() => {[39m
    [31m    engine.projectileCalculator.clearKeyframes();[39m
    [31m    renderAll();[39m
    [31m    battleSession.startTurnTimeout();[39m
    [31m  });[39m
    [31m};[39m

    [31m// --- Skill effect area preview (LoL-style hover indicator) ---[39m
    [31mfunction simulateDash(fromPos, targetPos, eff) {[39m
    [31m  const away = eff.direction === 'AWAY_FROM_TARGET';[39m
    [31m  const steps = eff.distance || 1;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  let dirQ, dirR;[39m
    [31m  if (away) {[39m
    [31m    const line = hexLine(targetPos.q, targetPos.r, fromPos.q, fromPos.r);[39m
    [31m    if (line.length < 2) return { q: fromPos.q, r: fromPos.r };[39m
    [31m    dirQ = line[1][0] - line[0][0];[39m
    [31m    dirR = line[1][1] - line[0][1];[39m
    [31m  } else {[39m
    [31m    const line = hexLine(fromPos.q, fromPos.r, targetPos.q, targetPos.r);[39m
    [31m    if (line.length < 2) return { q: fromPos.q, r: fromPos.r };[39m
    [31m    dirQ = line[1][0] - line[0][0];[39m
    [31m    dirR = line[1][1] - line[0][1];[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  let curQ = fromPos.q, curR = fromPos.r;[39m
    [31m  for (let s = 0; s < steps; s++) {[39m
    [31m    const nq = curQ + dirQ, nr = curR + dirR;[39m
    [31m    if (!isOnBoard(nq, nr)) break;[39m
    [31m    curQ = nq; curR = nr;[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m  return { q: curQ, r: curR };[39m
    [31m}[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31mfunction computeEffectArea(skill, charPos, hoveredTarget, rangeOverride = null) {[39m
    [31m  const area = new Set();[39m
    [31m  let simPos = { q: charPos.q, r: charPos.r };[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  for (const eff of skill.effects) {[39m
    [31m    switch (eff.cmd) {[39m
    [31m      case 'ATTACK_PROJECTILE':[39m
    [31m      case 'ATTACK_AOE_PATH': {[39m
    [31m        const line = hexLine(simPos.q, simPos.r, hoveredTarget.q, hoveredTarget.r);[39m
    [31m        for (const [q, r] of line) area.add(`${q},${r}`);[39m
    [31m        break;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      case 'ATTACK_MELEE': {[39m
    [31m        const dist = hexDistance(simPos.q, simPos.r, hoveredTarget.q, hoveredTarget.r);[39m
    [31m        if (dist <= (eff.range || 1)) area.add(`${hoveredTarget.q},${hoveredTarget.r}`);[39m
    [31m        break;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      case 'ATTACK_AOE_SELF':[39m
    [31m      case 'REACTIVE_ARMOR': {[39m
    [31m        const hexes = hexSpiral(simPos.q, simPos.r, eff.radius || 1);[39m
    [31m        for (const [q, r] of hexes) area.add(`${q},${r}`);[39m
    [31m        break;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      case 'SPAWN_STATIONARY_AOE': {[39m
    [31m        const center = (skill.targeting.shape === 'HEX' || skill.targeting.shape === 'FAN')[39m
    [31m          ? hoveredTarget : simPos;[39m
    [31m        const hexes = hexSpiral(center.q, center.r, eff.radius || 1);[39m
    [31m        for (const [q, r] of hexes) area.add(`${q},${r}`);[39m
    [31m        break;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      case 'ATTACK_AOE_TARGET': {[39m
    [31m        const hexes = hexSpiral(hoveredTarget.q, hoveredTarget.r, eff.radius || 1);[39m
    [31m        for (const [q, r] of hexes) area.add(`${q},${r}`);[39m
    [31m        break;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      case 'ATTACK_LINE': {[39m
    [31m        const fwdLine = hexLine(simPos.q, simPos.r, hoveredTarget.q, hoveredTarget.r);[39m
    [31m        // Forward: hexLine from caster through target, projectile starts from self[39m
    [31m        for (const [q, r] of fwdLine) {[39m
    [31m          area.add(`${q},${r}`);[39m
    [31m        }[39m
    [31m        // Reverse: opposite direction from caster to board edge[39m
    [31m        if (fwdLine.length >= 2) {[39m
    [31m          const dq = fwdLine[1][0] - fwdLine[0][0];[39m
    [31m          const dr = fwdLine[1][1] - fwdLine[0][1];[39m
    [31m          let curQ = simPos.q, curR = simPos.r;[39m
    [31m          for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {[39m
    [31m            curQ -= dq; curR -= dr;[39m
    [31m            if (!isOnBoard(curQ, curR)) break;[39m
    [31m            area.add(`${curQ},${curR}`);[39m
    [31m          }[39m
    [31m        }[39m
    [31m        break;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      case 'MOVE_DASH': {[39m
    [31m        simPos = simulateDash(simPos, hoveredTarget, eff);[39m
    [31m        area.add(`${simPos.q},${simPos.r}`);[39m
    [31m        break;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      case 'MOVE_GRAPNEL': {[39m
    [31m        const path = hexLine(simPos.q, simPos.r, hoveredTarget.q, hoveredTarget.r);[39m
    [31m        for (const [pq, pr] of path) {[39m
    [31m          const nearby = hexSpiral(pq, pr, 1);[39m
    [31m          for (const [nq, nr] of nearby) area.add(`${nq},${nr}`);[39m
    [31m        }[39m
    [31m        simPos = { q: hoveredTarget.q, r: hoveredTarget.r };[39m
    [31m        break;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      case 'MOVE_TELEPORT': {[39m
    [31m        if (eff.target === 'BEHIND_TARGET') {[39m
    [31m          const line = hexLine(simPos.q, simPos.r, hoveredTarget.q, hoveredTarget.r);[39m
    [31m          const behindDirQ = line.length >= 2 ? line[1][0] - line[0][0] : 0;[39m
    [31m          const behindDirR = line.length >= 2 ? line[1][1] - line[0][1] : 0;[39m
    [31m          simPos = { q: hoveredTarget.q + behindDirQ, r: hoveredTarget.r + behindDirR };[39m
    [31m        } else {[39m
    [31m          simPos = { q: hoveredTarget.q, r: hoveredTarget.r };[39m
    [31m        }[39m
    [31m        area.add(`${simPos.q},${simPos.r}`);[39m
    [31m        break;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      case 'MOVE_WALK': {[39m
    [31m        simPos = { q: hoveredTarget.q, r: hoveredTarget.r };[39m
    [31m        area.add(`${simPos.q},${simPos.r}`);[39m
    [31m        break;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      case 'MOVE_PULL': {[39m
    [31m        if (eff.target === 'FAN_AREA') {[39m
    [31m          const sectorRange = rangeOverride ?? skill.targeting?.range ?? 3;[39m
    [31m          const sectorHexes = getSectorHexes(charPos.q, charPos.r, hoveredTarget.q, hoveredTarget.r, sectorRange);[39m
    [31m          for (const [q, r] of sectorHexes) area.add(`${q},${r}`);[39m
    [31m        } else {[39m
    [31m          area.add(`${hoveredTarget.q},${hoveredTarget.r}`);[39m
    [31m          area.add(`${charPos.q},${charPos.r}`);[39m
    [31m        }[39m
    [31m        break;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      case 'CREATE_GATE': {[39m
    [31m        area.add(`${hoveredTarget.q},${hoveredTarget.r}`);[39m
    [31m        break;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      case 'CREATE_FORMATION': {[39m
    [31m        const hexes = hexSpiral(hoveredTarget.q, hoveredTarget.r, 1);[39m
    [31m        for (const [q, r] of hexes) area.add(`${q},${r}`);[39m
    [31m        break;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      case 'APPLY_STATUS': {[39m
    [31m        if (eff.status === 'METEOR_ASCENDING') {[39m
    [31m          const hexes = hexSpiral(hoveredTarget.q, hoveredTarget.r, 1);[39m
    [31m          for (const [q, r] of hexes) area.add(`${q},${r}`);[39m
    [31m        }[39m
    [31m        break;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m    }[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  return [...area].map(k => { const [q, r] = k.split(',').map(Number); return { q, r }; });[39m
    [31m}[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31mfunction getCharactersAtHex(q, r) {[39m
    [31m  return engine.getState().characters.filter(c =>[39m
    [31m    c.alive !== false && c.position?.q === q && c.position?.r === r[39m
    [31m  );[39m
    [31m}[39m
    [31mfunction getCharacterAtHex(q, r) {[39m
    [31m  const chars = getCharactersAtHex(q, r);[39m
    [31m  return chars[0] || null;[39m
    [31m}[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m// --- Canvas click ---[39m
    [31mcanvas.addEventListener('click', (e) => {[39m
    [31m  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();[39m
    [31m  const mx = e.clientX - rect.left, my = e.clientY - rect.top;[39m
    [31m  const [hq, hr] = pixelToHex(mx, my);[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  if (!isOnBoard(hq, hr)) return;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  const clickedChar = getCharacterAtHex(hq, hr);[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Galaxy sub-phase target selection (panel hidden, waiting for hex click)[39m
    [31m  if (battleSession.galaxyActive && battleSession.galaxySelectedSkill && !document.getElementById('galaxy-overlay').classList.contains('show')) {[39m
    [31m    const skill = SKILLS[battleSession.galaxySelectedSkill];[39m
    [31m    if (skill && skill.targeting.shape !== 'SELF' && skill.targeting.shape !== 'AOE_SELF') {[39m
    [31m      engine.submitGalaxyAction(battleSession.galaxySelectedSkill, { q: hq, r: hr });[39m
    [31m      if (networkManager && networkManager.mode !== 'local') {[39m
    [31m        networkManager.sendGalaxyAction(battleSession.galaxyCharId, battleSession.galaxySelectedSkill, { q: hq, r: hr });[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      battleSession.galaxySelectedSkill = null;[39m
    [31m      battleSession.validTargets = [];[39m
    [31m      battleSession.hoverEffectArea = [];[39m
    [31m      battleSession.hoveredHex = null;[39m
    [31m      document.getElementById('submit-status').textContent = '等待双方提交...';[39m
    [31m      return;[39m
    [31m    }[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // If only viewing opponent skill, clicking a hex clears the view[39m
    [31m  if (battleSession.viewingSkill && !battleSession.selectedSkill) {[39m
    [31m    battleSession.viewingSkill = null;[39m
    [31m    battleSession.validTargets = [];[39m
    [31m    battleSession.hoverEffectArea = [];[39m
    [31m    battleSession.hoveredHex = null;[39m
    [31m    if (clickedChar) battleSession.selectedCharacterId = clickedChar.id;[39m
    [31m    renderAll();[39m
    [31m    return;[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  if (!battleSession.selectedSkill) {[39m
    [31m    if (clickedChar) {[39m
    [31m      // Cycle through chars on same hex on repeated clicks[39m
    [31m      const hexChars = getCharactersAtHex(hq, hr);[39m
    [31m      if (hexChars.length > 1 && hexChars.some(c => c.id === battleSession.selectedCharacterId)) {[39m
    [31m        const curIdx = hexChars.findIndex(c => c.id === battleSession.selectedCharacterId);[39m
    [31m        const next = hexChars[(curIdx + 1) % hexChars.length];[39m
    [31m        battleSession.selectedCharacterId = next.id;[39m
    [31m        battleSession.lastHoveredCharacterId = next.id;[39m
    [31m      } else {[39m
    [31m        battleSession.selectedCharacterId = clickedChar.id;[39m
    [31m        battleSession.lastHoveredCharacterId = clickedChar.id;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      renderAll();[39m
    [31m    }[39m
    [31m    return;[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  const charId = battleSession.selectedSkill.charId;[39m
    [31m  const skill = SKILLS[battleSession.selectedSkill.skillId];[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  if (skill.targeting.shape === 'SELF' || skill.targeting.shape === 'AOE_SELF') {[39m
    [31m    battleSession.submitAction(charId, battleSession.selectedSkill.skillId, null);[39m
    [31m    return;[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Click on invalid hex cancels selection[39m
    [31m  if (!battleSession.validTargets.some(t => t.q === hq && t.r === hr)) {[39m
    [31m    battleSession.selectedSkill = null;[39m
    [31m    battleSession.validTargets = [];[39m
    [31m    battleSession.hoverEffectArea = [];[39m
    [31m    battleSession.hoveredHex = null;[39m
    [31m    renderAll();[39m
    [31m    return;[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  battleSession.submitAction(charId, battleSession.selectedSkill.skillId, { q: hq, r: hr });[39m
    [31m});[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m// [moved to BattleSessionController] battleSession.submitAction[39m

    [31m  if (networkManager && networkManager.mode !== 'local') {[39m

    [31m  if (isPveMode()) {[39m

    [31m});[39m

    [31m  if (battleConfigs) {[39m
    [31m    startBattleFromConfigs(Date.now(), battleConfigs);[39m

    [31m[39m
    [31m// --- Turn animation ---[39m
    [31masync function animateTurn() {[39m
    [31m  const keyframes = engine.projectileCalculator.generateKeyframes();[39m
    [31m  const animEvents = engine.projectileCalculator.getAnimEvents();[39m
    [31m  const projs = engine.projectileCalculator.projectiles;[39m
    [31m  if (keyframes.length === 0 && animEvents.length === 0 && projs.length === 0) return;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  const maxStep = Math.max([39m
    [31m    keyframes.reduce((max, kf) => Math.max(max, kf.step || 0), 0),[39m
    [31m    animEvents.reduce((max, e) => Math.max(max, (e.step || 0) + (e.duration || 1) - 1), 0)[39m
    [31m  );[39m
    [31m  const SUBFRAMES = 4;[39m
    [31m  const frameMs = 25;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  for (let s = 0; s <= maxStep; s++) {[39m
    [31m    const startSub = (s === 0) ? 0 : 1;[39m
    [31m    for (let sub = startSub; sub <= SUBFRAMES; sub++) {[39m
    [31m      const t = sub / SUBFRAMES;[39m
    [31m      await sleep(frameMs);[39m
    [31m      renderAll(s, t);[39m
    [31m    }[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m  await sleep(200);[39m
    [31m  renderAll(-1, 0);[39m
    [31m  engine.projectileCalculator.clearAnimEvents();[39m
    [31m}[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31mfunction sleep(ms) { return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m// --- Rendering ---[39m
    [31mfunction renderAll(animStep = -1, subT = 0) {[39m
    [31m  renderBoard(animStep, subT);[39m
    [31m  renderPanels();[39m
    [31m  renderLog();[39m
    [31m  document.getElementById('turn-num').textContent = engine.turnManager.turnNumber;[39m
    [31m  const phase = engine.turnManager.phase;[39m
    [31m  const phaseEl = document.getElementById('phase-text');[39m
    [31m  phaseEl.textContent = phase;[39m
    [31m  if (phase === 'EXECUTE') {[39m
    [31m    phaseEl.style.color = '#e05555';[39m
    [31m    phaseEl.style.animation = 'phase-pulse 0.6s ease-in-out';[39m
    [31m  } else {[39m
    [31m    phaseEl.style.color = '#DDBB99';[39m
    [31m    phaseEl.style.animation = 'none';[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m}[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31mfunction renderBoard(animStep = -1, subT = 0) {[39m
    [31m  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(Date.now() / 1000);[39m
    [31m  const projs = engine.projectileCalculator.projectiles;[39m
    [31m  const keyframes = engine.projectileCalculator.generateKeyframes();[39m
    [31m  const state = engine.getState();[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Pre-compute animation data from keyframes (projectiles may be dead/gone after resolution)[39m
    [31m  const projPositions = new Map(); // projId → { q, r, alive, isMelee, power, fromQ, fromR, toQ, toR }[39m
    [31m  const hitEvents = []; // { q, r, power, isMelee, age }[39m
    [31m  const slashEvents = []; // { fromQ, fromR, toQ, toR, power, progress }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Group keyframes by projectileId[39m
    [31m  const kfGroups = new Map();[39m
    [31m  for (const kf of keyframes) {[39m
    [31m    if (!kfGroups.has(kf.projectileId)) kfGroups.set(kf.projectileId, []);[39m
    [31m    kfGroups.get(kf.projectileId).push(kf);[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  if (animStep >= 0) {[39m
    [31m    for (const [projId, kfs] of kfGroups) {[39m
    [31m      kfs.sort((a, b) => a.step - b.step);[39m
    [31m      const firedKf = kfs.find(k => k.event === 'fired');[39m
    [31m      if (!firedKf) continue;[39m
    [31m      const isMelee = firedKf.flags?.includes('MELEE') || false;[39m
    [31m      const power = firedKf.power || 0;[39m
    [31m      const fromQ = firedKf.fromQ, fromR = firedKf.fromR;[39m
    [31m      const toQ = firedKf.toQ, toR = firedKf.toR;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m      // Find current position keyframe[39m
    [31m      let curKf = null, nextKf = null;[39m
    [31m      for (let i = kfs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {[39m
    [31m        if (kfs[i].step <= animStep) { curKf = kfs[i]; nextKf = kfs[i + 1] || null; break; }[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      if (!curKf && kfs.length > 0) { curKf = kfs[0]; nextKf = kfs[1] || null; }[39m
    [31m      if (!curKf) continue;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m      // Interpolated position[39m
    [31m      let iq = curKf.q, ir = curKf.r;[39m
    [31m      if (nextKf && nextKf.q !== undefined) {[39m
    [31m        iq = curKf.q + (nextKf.q - curKf.q) * subT;[39m
    [31m        ir = curKf.r + (nextKf.r - curKf.r) * subT;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m      // Alive based on keyframe timeline[39m
    [31m      const bodyContactStep = kfs.find(k => k.event === 'body_contact')?.step ?? Infinity;[39m
    [31m      const expiredStep = kfs.find(k => k.event === 'expired')?.step ?? Infinity;[39m
    [31m      const deathStep = Math.min(bodyContactStep, expiredStep);[39m
    [31m      const alive = animStep < deathStep || (animStep === deathStep && subT < 0.5);[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m      projPositions.set(projId, { q: iq, r: ir, alive, isMelee, power, fromQ, fromR, toQ, toR });[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m      // Hit / slash events at this animation step[39m
    [31m      const stepEvents = kfs.filter(k => k.step === animStep);[39m
    [31m      for (const evt of stepEvents) {[39m
    [31m        if (evt.event === 'body_contact') {[39m
    [31m          hitEvents.push({ q: evt.q, r: evt.r, power, isMelee, age: subT });[39m
    [31m        }[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      if (isMelee) {[39m
    [31m        for (const evt of stepEvents) {[39m
    [31m          if (evt.event === 'fired') {[39m
    [31m            slashEvents.push({ fromQ, fromR, toQ, toR, power, progress: subT });[39m
    [31m          }[39m
    [31m          if (evt.event === 'body_contact') {[39m
    [31m            slashEvents.push({ fromQ, fromR, toQ: evt.q, toR: evt.r, power, progress: 1 });[39m
    [31m          }[39m
    [31m        }[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m    }[39m
    [31m  } else {[39m
    [31m    // Static render: alive projectiles from arr[39m
    [31m    for (const proj of projs) {[39m
    [31m      if (!proj.alive) continue;[39m
    [31m      const [q, r] = proj.path[proj.stepIndex];[39m
    [31m      projPositions.set(proj.id, {[39m
    [31m        q, r, alive: true, isMelee: proj.flags.includes('MELEE'), power: proj.power,[39m
    [31m        fromQ: proj.fromQ, fromR: proj.fromR, toQ: proj.toQ, toR: proj.toR,[39m
    [31m      });[39m
    [31m    }[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // --- Draw hex grid ---[39m
    [31m  for (let q = -3; q <= 3; q++) {[39m
    [31m    for (let r = -3; r <= 3; r++) {[39m
    [31m      if (!isOnBoard(q, r)) continue;[39m
    [31m      const [cx, cy] = hexCenter(q, r);[39m
    [31m      const corners = hexCorners(cx, cy);[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m      ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m      ctx.moveTo(corners[0][0], corners[0][1]);[39m
    [31m      for (let i = 1; i < 6; i++) ctx.lineTo(corners[i][0], corners[i][1]);[39m
    [31m      ctx.closePath();[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m      const inEffectArea = battleSession.hoverEffectArea.some(t => t.q === q && t.r === r);[39m
    [31m      const isValidTarget = battleSession.validTargets.some(t => t.q === q && t.r === r);[39m
    [31m      const isHovered = battleSession.hoveredHex && battleSession.hoveredHex[0] === q && battleSession.hoveredHex[1] === r;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m      if (inEffectArea) {[39m
    [31m        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(212,148,58,${0.35 + pulse * 0.15})`;[39m
    [31m      } else if (isHovered && isValidTarget) {[39m
    [31m        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(221,187,153,${0.4 + pulse * 0.2})`;[39m
    [31m      } else if (isValidTarget) {[39m
    [31m        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(221,187,153,0.12)';[39m
    [31m      } else if (isHovered) {[39m
    [31m        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)';[39m
    [31m      } else {[39m
    [31m        ctx.fillStyle = '#1e1d2a';[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      ctx.fill();[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m      if (isHovered && isValidTarget) {[39m
    [31m        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(221,187,153,0.9)`;[39m
    [31m        ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;[39m
    [31m      } else if (inEffectArea) {[39m
    [31m        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(212,148,58,${0.7 + pulse * 0.3})`;[39m
    [31m        ctx.lineWidth = 1.8;[39m
    [31m      } else if (isValidTarget) {[39m
    [31m        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(221,187,153,0.3)';[39m
    [31m        ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;[39m
    [31m      } else {[39m
    [31m        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(83,81,100,0.4)';[39m
    [31m        ctx.lineWidth = 1;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      ctx.stroke();[39m
    [31m    }[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // --- Draw impact flashes (behind projectiles) ---[39m
    [31m  for (const hit of hitEvents) {[39m
    [31m    drawImpactEffect(hit.q, hit.r, hit.power, hit.isMelee, hit.age);[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // --- Draw melee slash arcs ---[39m
    [31m  for (const slash of slashEvents) {[39m
    [31m    drawSlashArc(slash.fromQ, slash.fromR, slash.toQ, slash.toR, slash.power, slash.progress);[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // --- Draw projectile trails ---[39m
    [31m  for (const [projId, pos] of projPositions) {[39m
    [31m    if (!pos.alive || pos.isMelee) continue;[39m
    [31m    drawProjectileTrail(projId, pos, animStep, keyframes);[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // --- Draw animation events (gather, dash, teleport, walk, grapple) ---[39m
    [31m  if (animStep >= 0) {[39m
    [31m    const animEvents = engine.projectileCalculator.getAnimEvents();[39m
    [31m    for (const evt of animEvents) {[39m
    [31m      const evtStart = evt.step;[39m
    [31m      const evtEnd = evtStart + (evt.duration || 1);[39m
    [31m      if (animStep < evtStart || animStep >= evtEnd) continue;[39m
    [31m      const evtProgress = (animStep - evtStart + subT) / (evt.duration || 1);[39m
    [31m      switch (evt.event) {[39m
    [31m        case 'gather': drawGatherEffect(evt.q, evt.r, evt.color, evt.amount, evtProgress); break;[39m
    [31m        case 'dash': drawDashTrail(evt.fromQ, evt.fromR, evt.toQ, evt.toR, evtProgress); break;[39m
    [31m        case 'teleport': drawTeleportEffect(evt.fromQ, evt.fromR, evt.toQ, evt.toR, evtProgress); break;[39m
    [31m        case 'walk': drawWalkTrail(evt.fromQ, evt.fromR, evt.toQ, evt.toR, evtProgress); break;[39m
    [31m        case 'grapple': drawGrappleLine(evt.fromQ, evt.fromR, evt.toQ, evt.toR, evtProgress); break;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m    }[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // --- Draw entities ---[39m
    [31m  // Group characters by hex to split overlapping positions[39m
    [31m  const charsByHex = new Map();[39m
    [31m  const allChars = [];[39m
    [31m  for (const e of engine.registry.entities()) {[39m
    [31m    if (e.type === 'CHARACTER' && e.alive !== false) {[39m
    [31m      allChars.push(e);[39m
    [31m      const key = `${e.position.q},${e.position.r}`;[39m
    [31m      if (!charsByHex.has(key)) charsByHex.set(key, []);[39m
    [31m      charsByHex.get(key).push(e);[39m
    [31m    }[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Compute offset positions for characters sharing a hex[39m
    [31m  const charDrawPos = new Map(); // entityId -> {cx, cy}[39m
    [31m  for (const [key, chars] of charsByHex) {[39m
    [31m    const [hcx, hcy] = hexCenter(chars[0].position.q, chars[0].position.r);[39m
    [31m    if (chars.length === 1) {[39m
    [31m      charDrawPos.set(chars[0].id, { cx: hcx, cy: hcy });[39m
    [31m    } else if (chars.length === 2) {[39m
    [31m      charDrawPos.set(chars[0].id, { cx: hcx - 12, cy: hcy - 5 });[39m
    [31m      charDrawPos.set(chars[1].id, { cx: hcx + 12, cy: hcy + 5 });[39m
    [31m    } else {[39m
    [31m      const r = 14;[39m
    [31m      for (let i = 0; i < chars.length; i++) {[39m
    [31m        const angle = (i / chars.length) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;[39m
    [31m        charDrawPos.set(chars[i].id, { cx: hcx + Math.cos(angle) * r, cy: hcy + Math.sin(angle) * r });[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m    }[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  for (const e of engine.registry.entities()) {[39m
    [31m    if (e.alive === false) continue;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m    if (e.type === 'CHARACTER') {[39m
    [31m      const pos = charDrawPos.get(e.id) || hexCenter(e.position.q, e.position.r);[39m
    [31m      const cx = pos.cx, cy = pos.cy;[39m
    [31m      const charColor = e.class === '法师' ? '#8b5cf6' : e.class === '战士' ? '#e05555' : '#d4943a';[39m
    [31m      const charLabel = e.class === '法师' ? '法' : e.class === '战士' ? '战' : '射';[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m      // Hit flash: check if this character's hex is at a hit position[39m
    [31m      let hitFlash = 0;[39m
    [31m      for (const hit of hitEvents) {[39m
    [31m        if (hit.q === e.position.q && hit.r === e.position.r) { hitFlash = 1 - hit.age; break; }[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m      ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m      ctx.arc(cx, cy, 18, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m      if (hitFlash > 0.3) {[39m
    [31m        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${hitFlash})`;[39m
    [31m      } else {[39m
    [31m        ctx.fillStyle = charColor;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      ctx.fill();[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m      ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';[39m
    [31m      ctx.lineWidth = 2 + hitFlash * 3;[39m
    [31m      ctx.stroke();[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';[39m
    [31m      ctx.font = 'bold 14px \"KaiTi\",\"STKaiti\",serif';[39m
    [31m      ctx.textAlign = 'center';[39m
    [31m      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';[39m
    [31m      ctx.fillText(charLabel, cx, cy);[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m      // p1/p2 badge[39m
    [31m      const badge = e.ownerId === 'player1' ? '1P' : '2P';[39m
    [31m      ctx.fillStyle = e.ownerId === 'player1' ? '#8b5cf6' : '#d4943a';[39m
    [31m      ctx.font = 'bold 9px sans-serif';[39m
    [31m      ctx.textAlign = 'left';[39m
    [31m      ctx.textBaseline = 'top';[39m
    [31m      ctx.fillText(badge, cx + 13, cy + 10);[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m      const pool = engine.resourceSystem.getAll(e.id);[39m
    [31m      if (pool.shieldActive) {[39m
    [31m        ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m        ctx.arc(cx, cy, 23, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m        ctx.strokeStyle = '#8b5cf6';[39m
    [31m        ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;[39m
    [31m        ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);[39m
    [31m        ctx.stroke();[39m
    [31m        ctx.setLineDash([]);[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m    }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m    if (e.type === 'GATE') {[39m
    [31m      const [cx, cy] = hexCenter(e.position.q, e.position.r);[39m
    [31m      ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m      ctx.arc(cx, cy, 18, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(139,92,246,0.15)';[39m
    [31m      ctx.fill();[39m
    [31m      ctx.strokeStyle = '#8b5cf6';[39m
    [31m      ctx.lineWidth = 2;[39m
    [31m      ctx.setLineDash([3, 3]);[39m
    [31m      ctx.stroke();[39m
    [31m      ctx.setLineDash([]);[39m
    [31m    }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m    if (e.type === 'FORMATION') {[39m
    [31m      const formation = engine.formationSystem.getFormation(e.id);[39m
    [31m      const hexes = formation ? formation.coverageHexes : [[e.position.q, e.position.r]];[39m
    [31m      for (const [hq, hr] of hexes) {[39m
    [31m        const [hcx, hcy] = hexCenter(hq, hr);[39m
    [31m        ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m        ctx.arc(hcx, hcy, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(139,92,246,0.12)';[39m
    [31m        ctx.fill();[39m
    [31m        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(139,92,246,0.4)';[39m
    [31m        ctx.lineWidth = 1;[39m
    [31m        ctx.setLineDash([2, 3]);[39m
    [31m        ctx.stroke();[39m
    [31m        ctx.setLineDash([]);[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m    }[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // --- Draw weak point indicators (心眼) ---[39m
    [31m  const dirVectors = [[1,0],[1,-1],[0,-1],[-1,0],[-1,1],[0,1]];[39m
    [31m  for (const e of state.characters) {[39m
    [31m    if (e.alive === false) continue;[39m
    [31m    const wp = e.buffs.find(b => b.statusType === 'WEAK_POINT');[39m
    [31m    if (!wp || !wp.data?.directions) continue;[39m
    [31m    const [cx, cy] = hexCenter(e.position.q, e.position.r);[39m
    [31m    for (const d of wp.data.directions) {[39m
    [31m      const [dq, dr] = dirVectors[d];[39m
    [31m      const [nx, ny] = hexCenter(e.position.q + dq, e.position.r + dr);[39m
    [31m      const ang = Math.atan2(ny - cy, nx - cx); // arrow points outward (from char toward neighbor)[39m
    [31m      const dist = 10;[39m
    [31m      const sx = cx + dist * Math.cos(ang);[39m
    [31m      const sy = cy + dist * Math.sin(ang);[39m
    [31m      // Arrowhead points toward neighbor[39m
    [31m      ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m      ctx.moveTo(sx, sy);[39m
    [31m      ctx.lineTo(sx + 7 * Math.cos(ang + 0.5), sy + 7 * Math.sin(ang + 0.5));[39m
    [31m      ctx.lineTo(sx + 7 * Math.cos(ang - 0.5), sy + 7 * Math.sin(ang - 0.5));[39m
    [31m      ctx.closePath();[39m
    [31m      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(220,60,60,0.85)';[39m
    [31m      ctx.fill();[39m
    [31m      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(180,30,30,0.9)';[39m
    [31m      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;[39m
    [31m      ctx.stroke();[39m
    [31m    }[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // --- Draw projectiles (non-melee) ---[39m
    [31m  for (const [projId, pos] of projPositions) {[39m
    [31m    if (!pos.alive || pos.isMelee) continue;[39m
    [31m    const [cx, cy] = hexCenter(pos.q, pos.r);[39m
    [31m    const size = 5 + Math.min(10, pos.power / 50);[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m    // Glow[39m
    [31m    ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m    ctx.arc(cx, cy, size + 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';[39m
    [31m    ctx.fill();[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m    // Core[39m
    [31m    ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m    ctx.arc(cx, cy, size, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, size);[39m
    [31m    g.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');[39m
    [31m    g.addColorStop(0.3, '#ffcc66');[39m
    [31m    g.addColorStop(0.7, '#e05555');[39m
    [31m    g.addColorStop(1, '#801010');[39m
    [31m    ctx.fillStyle = g;[39m
    [31m    ctx.fill();[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m    // Power label[39m
    [31m    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';[39m
    [31m    ctx.font = 'bold 9px sans-serif';[39m
    [31m    ctx.textAlign = 'center';[39m
    [31m    ctx.fillText(Math.round(pos.power), cx, cy - 14);[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // --- Draw casings ---[39m
    [31m  for (const c of state.casings) {[39m
    [31m    const [cx, cy] = hexCenter(c.q, c.r);[39m
    [31m    ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m    ctx.arc(cx + 10, cy + 10, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m    ctx.fillStyle = '#c9a96e';[39m
    [31m    ctx.fill();[39m
    [31m    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1410';[39m
    [31m    ctx.font = 'bold 9px sans-serif';[39m
    [31m    ctx.textAlign = 'center';[39m
    [31m    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';[39m
    [31m    ctx.fillText(c.count, cx + 10, cy + 10);[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // --- Draw wild bullets ---[39m
    [31m  for (const wb of state.wildBullets) {[39m
    [31m    const [cx, cy] = hexCenter(wb.q, wb.r);[39m
    [31m    ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m    ctx.arc(cx - 10, cy + 10, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m    ctx.fillStyle = '#d4943a';[39m
    [31m    ctx.fill();[39m
    [31m    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';[39m
    [31m    ctx.lineWidth = 1;[39m
    [31m    ctx.stroke();[39m
    [31m    ctx.fillStyle = '#f5eedc';[39m
    [31m    ctx.font = 'bold 9px sans-serif';[39m
    [31m    ctx.textAlign = 'center';[39m
    [31m    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';[39m
    [31m    ctx.fillText('W', cx - 10, cy + 10);[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // --- Draw submitted indicator ---[39m
    [31m  for (const c of engine.registry.characters()) {[39m
    [31m    if (c.alive === false) continue;[39m
    [31m    if (battleSession.localSubmittedSet.has(c.id) || battleSession.remoteSubmittedSet.has(c.id)) {[39m
    [31m      const [cx, cy] = hexCenter(c.position.q, c.position.r);[39m
    [31m      const isLocal = battleSession.localSubmittedSet.has(c.id);[39m
    [31m      ctx.fillStyle = isLocal ? '#5a9e7e' : '#7b9fff';[39m
    [31m      ctx.font = 'bold 20px sans-serif';[39m
    [31m      ctx.textAlign = 'center';[39m
    [31m      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';[39m
    [31m      ctx.fillText('✓', cx, cy - 28);[39m
    [31m    }[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m}[39m

    [31mfunction drawSlashArc(fromQ, fromR, toQ, toR, power, progress) {[39m
    [31m  const [fx, fy] = hexCenter(fromQ, fromR);[39m
    [31m  const [tx, ty] = hexCenter(toQ, toR);[39m
    [31m  const midX = (fx + tx) / 2, midY = (fy + ty) / 2;[39m
    [31m  const dx = tx - fx, dy = ty - fy;[39m
    [31m  const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);[39m
    [31m  const perpX = -dy / (dist || 1), perpY = dx / (dist || 1);[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  const alpha = progress < 0.5 ? progress * 2 : (1 - progress) * 2;[39m
    [31m  const arcSize = 20 + power / 20;[39m
    [31m  const thickness = 3 + power / 100;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  ctx.save();[39m
    [31m  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Outer glow[39m
    [31m  ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m  ctx.moveTo(fx, fy);[39m
    [31m  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(midX + perpX * arcSize, midY + perpY * arcSize, tx, ty);[39m
    [31m  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';[39m
    [31m  ctx.lineWidth = thickness + 6;[39m
    [31m  ctx.lineCap = 'round';[39m
    [31m  ctx.stroke();[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Inner bright arc[39m
    [31m  ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m  ctx.moveTo(fx, fy);[39m
    [31m  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(midX + perpX * arcSize * 0.7, midY + perpY * arcSize * 0.7, tx, ty);[39m
    [31m  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,220,150,0.9)';[39m
    [31m  ctx.lineWidth = thickness;[39m
    [31m  ctx.stroke();[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Core white arc[39m
    [31m  ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m  ctx.moveTo(fx, fy);[39m
    [31m  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(midX + perpX * arcSize * 0.5, midY + perpY * arcSize * 0.5, tx, ty);[39m
    [31m  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,1)';[39m
    [31m  ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, thickness - 1);[39m
    [31m  ctx.stroke();[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  ctx.restore();[39m
    [31m}[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31mfunction drawImpactEffect(q, r, power, isMelee, age) {[39m
    [31m  const [cx, cy] = hexCenter(q, r);[39m
    [31m  const alpha = 1 - age;[39m
    [31m  if (alpha <= 0) return;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  const baseRadius = 10 + power / 30;[39m
    [31m  const ringCount = isMelee ? 2 : 1;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  ctx.save();[39m
    [31m  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  for (let i = 0; i < ringCount; i++) {[39m
    [31m    const r1 = baseRadius + age * 35 + i * 8;[39m
    [31m    const r2 = baseRadius + age * 20 + i * 5;[39m
    [31m    if (r1 < 50) {[39m
    [31m      // Expanding shock ring[39m
    [31m      ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m      ctx.arc(cx, cy, r1, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m      ctx.strokeStyle = isMelee ? 'rgba(255,200,100,0.7)' : 'rgba(255,150,80,0.6)';[39m
    [31m      ctx.lineWidth = 3 - age * 2;[39m
    [31m      ctx.stroke();[39m
    [31m    }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m    // Inner filled circle[39m
    [31m    ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m    ctx.arc(cx, cy, r2, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, r2);[39m
    [31m    g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)');[39m
    [31m    g.addColorStop(0.3, isMelee ? 'rgba(255,220,120,0.5)' : 'rgba(255,180,60,0.4)');[39m
    [31m    g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,100,30,0)');[39m
    [31m    ctx.fillStyle = g;[39m
    [31m    ctx.fill();[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Spark particles[39m
    [31m  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {[39m
    [31m    const angle = (i / 6) * Math.PI * 2 + age * 2;[39m
    [31m    const dist = age * 30 + 5;[39m
    [31m    const sx = cx + Math.cos(angle) * dist;[39m
    [31m    const sy = cy + Math.sin(angle) * dist;[39m
    [31m    const sparkSize = 2 - age * 1.5;[39m
    [31m    if (sparkSize > 0.3) {[39m
    [31m      ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m      ctx.arc(sx, sy, sparkSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,240,200,${alpha})`;[39m
    [31m      ctx.fill();[39m
    [31m    }[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  ctx.restore();[39m
    [31m}[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31mfunction drawProjectileTrail(projId, pos, animStep, keyframes) {[39m
    [31m  if (animStep < 1) return;[39m
    [31m  const projKfs = keyframes.filter(k => k.projectileId === projId).sort((a, b) => a.step - b.step);[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  for (let i = 1; i <= Math.min(3, animStep); i++) {[39m
    [31m    const kfIdx = animStep - i;[39m
    [31m    let trailQ, trailR;[39m
    [31m    if (kfIdx >= 0 && kfIdx < projKfs.length) {[39m
    [31m      trailQ = projKfs[kfIdx].q;[39m
    [31m      trailR = projKfs[kfIdx].r;[39m
    [31m    } else if (pos.prevQ !== undefined) {[39m
    [31m      trailQ = pos.prevQ; trailR = pos.prevR;[39m
    [31m    } else continue;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m    const [cx, cy] = hexCenter(trailQ, trailR);[39m
    [31m    const alpha = (3 - i) / 3 * 0.4;[39m
    [31m    const size = 3 + i;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m    ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m    ctx.arc(cx, cy, size, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,200,100,${alpha})`;[39m
    [31m    ctx.fill();[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m}[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31mfunction drawGatherEffect(q, r, color, amount, progress) {[39m
    [31m  const [cx, cy] = hexCenter(q, r);[39m
    [31m  // Longer peak: alpha stays high for middle 60% of animation[39m
    [31m  const peak = 1 - Math.abs(progress - 0.5) * 1.4;[39m
    [31m  const alpha = Math.max(0, peak);[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  ctx.save();[39m
    [31m  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha * 0.85;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Pulsing rings (2 rings at different phases)[39m
    [31m  for (let ring = 0; ring < 2; ring++) {[39m
    [31m    const rp = (progress + ring * 0.3) % 1;[39m
    [31m    const radius = 16 + rp * 28;[39m
    [31m    ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m    ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m    ctx.strokeStyle = color;[39m
    [31m    ctx.lineWidth = 3 - rp * 2;[39m
    [31m    ctx.stroke();[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Inner bright glow[39m
    [31m  const glowR = 12 + Math.sin(progress * Math.PI) * 10;[39m
    [31m  ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m  ctx.arc(cx, cy, glowR, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, glowR);[39m
    [31m  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)');[39m
    [31m  g.addColorStop(0.3, color);[39m
    [31m  g.addColorStop(1, 'transparent');[39m
    [31m  ctx.fillStyle = g;[39m
    [31m  ctx.fill();[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Particles spiraling upward (8 particles)[39m
    [31m  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {[39m
    [31m    const baseAngle = (i / 8) * Math.PI * 2;[39m
    [31m    const angle = baseAngle + progress * 4;[39m
    [31m    const dist = 10 + progress * 28;[39m
    [31m    const px = cx + Math.cos(angle) * dist;[39m
    [31m    const py = cy + Math.sin(angle) * dist * 0.6 - progress * 26;[39m
    [31m    const pSize = 3.5 - progress * 1.5;[39m
    [31m    if (pSize > 0.5) {[39m
    [31m      ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m      ctx.arc(px, py, pSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m      ctx.fillStyle = i % 2 === 0 ? '#ffffff' : color;[39m
    [31m      ctx.fill();[39m
    [31m    }[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Amount text floating up[39m
    [31m  if (amount > 0 && progress < 0.8) {[39m
    [31m    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${1 - progress})`;[39m
    [31m    ctx.font = 'bold 14px \"KaiTi\",serif';[39m
    [31m    ctx.textAlign = 'center';[39m
    [31m    ctx.fillText(`+${amount}`, cx, cy - 30 - progress * 24);[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  ctx.restore();[39m
    [31m}[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31mfunction drawDashTrail(fromQ, fromR, toQ, toR, progress) {[39m
    [31m  const [fx, fy] = hexCenter(fromQ, fromR);[39m
    [31m  const [tx, ty] = hexCenter(toQ, toR);[39m
    [31m  const dx = tx - fx, dy = ty - fy;[39m
    [31m  const perpX = -dy * 0.3, perpY = dx * 0.3;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  ctx.save();[39m
    [31m  const alpha = 0.7 - progress * 0.5;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Speed lines along dash path[39m
    [31m  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {[39m
    [31m    const t = (i / 4) + progress * 0.3;[39m
    [31m    if (t > 1) continue;[39m
    [31m    const lx = fx + dx * Math.max(0, t - 0.2);[39m
    [31m    const ly = fy + dy * Math.max(0, t - 0.2);[39m
    [31m    const rx = fx + dx * Math.min(1, t + 0.1);[39m
    [31m    const ry = fy + dy * Math.min(1, t + 0.1);[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m    ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m    ctx.moveTo(lx + perpX, ly + perpY);[39m
    [31m    ctx.lineTo(rx + perpX, ry + perpY);[39m
    [31m    ctx.moveTo(lx - perpX, ly - perpY);[39m
    [31m    ctx.lineTo(rx - perpX, ry - perpY);[39m
    [31m    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha * 0.5})`;[39m
    [31m    ctx.lineWidth = 2;[39m
    [31m    ctx.stroke();[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Ghost afterimages[39m
    [31m  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {[39m
    [31m    const t = progress - (i + 1) * 0.15;[39m
    [31m    if (t < 0) continue;[39m
    [31m    const gx = fx + dx * t;[39m
    [31m    const gy = fy + dy * t;[39m
    [31m    ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m    ctx.arc(gx, gy, 18, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.15 - i * 0.04})`;[39m
    [31m    ctx.fill();[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  ctx.restore();[39m
    [31m}[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31mfunction drawTeleportEffect(fromQ, fromR, toQ, toR, progress) {[39m
    [31m  const [fx, fy] = hexCenter(fromQ, fromR);[39m
    [31m  const [tx, ty] = hexCenter(toQ, toR);[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  ctx.save();[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Origin flash (fading out)[39m
    [31m  const outAlpha = (1 - progress) * 0.8;[39m
    [31m  if (outAlpha > 0) {[39m
    [31m    ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m    ctx.arc(fx, fy, 22 + progress * 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(139,92,246,${outAlpha * 0.3})`;[39m
    [31m    ctx.fill();[39m
    [31m    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${outAlpha})`;[39m
    [31m    ctx.lineWidth = 3;[39m
    [31m    ctx.stroke();[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Destination flash (fading in)[39m
    [31m  const inAlpha = progress * 0.8;[39m
    [31m  if (inAlpha > 0) {[39m
    [31m    ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m    ctx.arc(tx, ty, 22 + (1 - progress) * 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(139,92,246,${inAlpha * 0.3})`;[39m
    [31m    ctx.fill();[39m
    [31m    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${inAlpha})`;[39m
    [31m    ctx.lineWidth = 3;[39m
    [31m    ctx.stroke();[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m    // Inner bright core[39m
    [31m    ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m    ctx.arc(tx, ty, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${inAlpha * 0.9})`;[39m
    [31m    ctx.fill();[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  ctx.restore();[39m
    [31m}[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31mfunction drawWalkTrail(fromQ, fromR, toQ, toR, progress) {[39m
    [31m  const [fx, fy] = hexCenter(fromQ, fromR);[39m
    [31m  const [tx, ty] = hexCenter(toQ, toR);[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  ctx.save();[39m
    [31m  // Simple dust puffs along the path[39m
    [31m  for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {[39m
    [31m    const t = progress - i * 0.3;[39m
    [31m    if (t < 0 || t > 1) continue;[39m
    [31m    const px = fx + (tx - fx) * t;[39m
    [31m    const py = fy + (ty - fy) * t;[39m
    [31m    const alpha = (1 - i * 0.3) * 0.4 * (1 - progress);[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m    ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m    ctx.arc(px + (i - 0.5) * 8, py + 12, 4 + progress * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);[39m
    [31m    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(200,190,180,${alpha})`;[39m
    [31m    ctx.fill();[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m  ctx.restore();[39m
    [31m}[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31mfunction drawGrappleLine(fromQ, fromR, toQ, toR, progress) {[39m
    [31m  const [fx, fy] = hexCenter(fromQ, fromR);[39m
    [31m  const [tx, ty] = hexCenter(toQ, toR);[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  ctx.save();[39m
    [31m  // Rope/chain line[39m
    [31m  ctx.beginPath();[39m
    [31m  ctx.moveTo(fx, fy);[39m
    [31m  ctx.lineTo(tx, ty);[39m
    [31m  ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(180,160,140,0.6)`;[39m
    [31m  ctx.lineWidth = 2;[39m
    [31m  ctx.setLineDash([4, 3]);[39m
    [31m  ctx.stroke();[39m
    [31m  ctx.setLineDash([]);[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Hook head at destination[39m
    [31m  const hookAlpha = progress > 0.5 ? 1 : progress * 2;[39m
    [31m  ctx.beginPath();[39m

    [31mfunction shiftRole(delta) {[39m

    [31m  if (!gameoverShown && battleSession.battleActive) {[39m
    [31m    pendingRemoteRematchClass = remoteClass;[39m
    [31m    return;[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m  remoteClassPick = remoteClass;[39m
    [31m  if (seed) battleSeed = seed;[39m
    [31m  // Opponent clicked first while we're in game-over screen — show indicator[39m
    [31m  if (gameoverShown && !pendingMyClass) {[39m
    [31m    opponentReadyForRematch = true;[39m
    [31m    updateRematchButton();[39m
    [31m    return;[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m  // Both sides have clicked: start the game[39m
    [31m  const myClass = pendingMyClass || document.getElementById('p2p-class-select').value;[39m
    [31m  // If we already clicked (premature sender), re-send our class so the other[39m
    [31m  // side gets a fresh CLASS_PICK while their game-over is showing[39m
    [31m  if (pendingMyClass) {[39m
    [31m    nm.sendClassPick(myClass, battleSeed);[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m  pendingMyClass = null;[39m
    [31m  opponentReadyForRematch = false;[39m
    [31m  tryInitWithClasses(nm, myClass);[39m
    [31m}[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31mfunction tryInitWithClasses(nm, myClass) {[39m
    [31m  if (!remoteClassPick) return;[39m
    [31m  const myId = nm.myPlayerId;[39m
    [31m  const p1Class = myId === 'player1' ? myClass : remoteClassPick;[39m
    [31m  const p2Class = myId === 'player2' ? myClass : remoteClassPick;[39m
    [31m  remoteClassPick = null; // reset for reconnection[39m
    [31m  battleSession.initGame(p1Class, p2Class, battleSeed);[39m
    [31m  battleSeed = 0; // reset for next game[39m
    [31m  document.getElementById('submit-status').textContent = '等待双方提交...';[39m
    [31m  battleSession.startTurnTimeout();[39m
    [31m}[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31mconst handleRemoteAction = (nm, action) => {[39m
    [31m  // Apply opponent's action to our local engine[39m
    [31m  engine.submitAction(action.charId, action.skillId, action.targetPos ?? null);[39m
    [31m  if (battleSession.isRequiredActionReady(action.charId)) battleSession.remoteSubmittedSet.add(action.charId);[39m
    [31m  battleSession.updateSubmitStatus(nm);[39m
    [31m  renderAll();[39m
    [31m};[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31mconst executeP2PTurn = async (nm) => {[39m
    [31m  battleSession.clearTurnTimeout();[39m
    [31m  const result = await engine.executeTurn();[39m
    [31m  if (!result.success) return;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  battleSession.localSubmittedSet.clear();[39m
    [31m  battleSession.remoteSubmittedSet.clear();[39m
    [31m  battleSession.clearPlannedActions();[39m

    [31m  if (result.battleEnded) {[39m
    [31m    renderAll();[39m
    [31m    return;[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  animateTurn().then(() => {[39m
    [31m    engine.projectileCalculator.clearKeyframes();[39m
    [31m    renderAll();[39m
    [31m    battleSession.startTurnTimeout();[39m
    [31m  });[39m
    [31m};[39m

    [31m// --- Skill effect area preview (LoL-style hover indicator) ---[39m
    [31mfunction simulateDash(fromPos, targetPos, eff) {[39m
    [31m  const away = eff.direction === 'AWAY_FROM_TARGET';[39m
    [31m  const steps = eff.distance || 1;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  let dirQ, dirR;[39m
    [31m  if (away) {[39m
    [31m    const line = hexLine(targetPos.q, targetPos.r, fromPos.q, fromPos.r);[39m
    [31m    if (line.length < 2) return { q: fromPos.q, r: fromPos.r };[39m
    [31m    dirQ = line[1][0] - line[0][0];[39m
    [31m    dirR = line[1][1] - line[0][1];[39m
    [31m  } else {[39m
    [31m    const line = hexLine(fromPos.q, fromPos.r, targetPos.q, targetPos.r);[39m
    [31m    if (line.length < 2) return { q: fromPos.q, r: fromPos.r };[39m
    [31m    dirQ = line[1][0] - line[0][0];[39m
    [31m    dirR = line[1][1] - line[0][1];[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  let curQ = fromPos.q, curR = fromPos.r;[39m
    [31m  for (let s = 0; s < steps; s++) {[39m
    [31m    const nq = curQ + dirQ, nr = curR + dirR;[39m
    [31m    if (!isOnBoard(nq, nr)) break;[39m
    [31m    curQ = nq; curR = nr;[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m  return { q: curQ, r: curR };[39m
    [31m}[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31mfunction computeEffectArea(skill, charPos, hoveredTarget, rangeOverride = null) {[39m
    [31m  const area = new Set();[39m
    [31m  let simPos = { q: charPos.q, r: charPos.r };[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  for (const eff of skill.effects) {[39m
    [31m    switch (eff.cmd) {[39m
    [31m      case 'ATTACK_PROJECTILE':[39m
    [31m      case 'ATTACK_AOE_PATH': {[39m
    [31m        const line = hexLine(simPos.q, simPos.r, hoveredTarget.q, hoveredTarget.r);[39m
    [31m        for (const [q, r] of line) area.add(`${q},${r}`);[39m
    [31m        break;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      case 'ATTACK_MELEE': {[39m
    [31m        const dist = hexDistance(simPos.q, simPos.r, hoveredTarget.q, hoveredTarget.r);[39m
    [31m        if (dist <= (eff.range || 1)) area.add(`${hoveredTarget.q},${hoveredTarget.r}`);[39m
    [31m        break;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      case 'ATTACK_AOE_SELF':[39m
    [31m      case 'REACTIVE_ARMOR': {[39m
    [31m        const hexes = hexSpiral(simPos.q, simPos.r, eff.radius || 1);[39m
    [31m        for (const [q, r] of hexes) area.add(`${q},${r}`);[39m
    [31m        break;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      case 'SPAWN_STATIONARY_AOE': {[39m
    [31m        const center = (skill.targeting.shape === 'HEX' || skill.targeting.shape === 'FAN')[39m
    [31m          ? hoveredTarget : simPos;[39m
    [31m        const hexes = hexSpiral(center.q, center.r, eff.radius || 1);[39m
    [31m        for (const [q, r] of hexes) area.add(`${q},${r}`);[39m
    [31m        break;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      case 'ATTACK_AOE_TARGET': {[39m
    [31m        const hexes = hexSpiral(hoveredTarget.q, hoveredTarget.r, eff.radius || 1);[39m
    [31m        for (const [q, r] of hexes) area.add(`${q},${r}`);[39m
    [31m        break;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      case 'ATTACK_LINE': {[39m
    [31m        const fwdLine = hexLine(simPos.q, simPos.r, hoveredTarget.q, hoveredTarget.r);[39m
    [31m        // Forward: hexLine from caster through target, projectile starts from self[39m
    [31m        for (const [q, r] of fwdLine) {[39m
    [31m          area.add(`${q},${r}`);[39m
    [31m        }[39m
    [31m        // Reverse: opposite direction from caster to board edge[39m
    [31m        if (fwdLine.length >= 2) {[39m
    [31m          const dq = fwdLine[1][0] - fwdLine[0][0];[39m
    [31m          const dr = fwdLine[1][1] - fwdLine[0][1];[39m
    [31m          let curQ = simPos.q, curR = simPos.r;[39m
    [31m          for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {[39m
    [31m            curQ -= dq; curR -= dr;[39m
    [31m            if (!isOnBoard(curQ, curR)) break;[39m
    [31m            area.add(`${curQ},${curR}`);[39m
    [31m          }[39m
    [31m        }[39m
    [31m        break;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      case 'MOVE_DASH': {[39m
    [31m        simPos = simulateDash(simPos, hoveredTarget, eff);[39m
    [31m        area.add(`${simPos.q},${simPos.r}`);[39m
    [31m        break;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      case 'MOVE_GRAPNEL': {[39m
    [31m        const path = hexLine(simPos.q, simPos.r, hoveredTarget.q, hoveredTarget.r);[39m
    [31m        for (const [pq, pr] of path) {[39m
    [31m          const nearby = hexSpiral(pq, pr, 1);[39m
    [31m          for (const [nq, nr] of nearby) area.add(`${nq},${nr}`);[39m
    [31m        }[39m
    [31m        simPos = { q: hoveredTarget.q, r: hoveredTarget.r };[39m
    [31m        break;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      case 'MOVE_TELEPORT': {[39m
    [31m        if (eff.target === 'BEHIND_TARGET') {[39m
    [31m          const line = hexLine(simPos.q, simPos.r, hoveredTarget.q, hoveredTarget.r);[39m
    [31m          const behindDirQ = line.length >= 2 ? line[1][0] - line[0][0] : 0;[39m
    [31m          const behindDirR = line.length >= 2 ? line[1][1] - line[0][1] : 0;[39m
    [31m          simPos = { q: hoveredTarget.q + behindDirQ, r: hoveredTarget.r + behindDirR };[39m
    [31m        } else {[39m
    [31m          simPos = { q: hoveredTarget.q, r: hoveredTarget.r };[39m
    [31m        }[39m
    [31m        area.add(`${simPos.q},${simPos.r}`);[39m
    [31m        break;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      case 'MOVE_WALK': {[39m
    [31m        simPos = { q: hoveredTarget.q, r: hoveredTarget.r };[39m
    [31m        area.add(`${simPos.q},${simPos.r}`);[39m
    [31m        break;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      case 'MOVE_PULL': {[39m
    [31m        if (eff.target === 'FAN_AREA') {[39m
    [31m          const sectorRange = rangeOverride ?? skill.targeting?.range ?? 3;[39m
    [31m          const sectorHexes = getSectorHexes(charPos.q, charPos.r, hoveredTarget.q, hoveredTarget.r, sectorRange);[39m
    [31m          for (const [q, r] of sectorHexes) area.add(`${q},${r}`);[39m
    [31m        } else {[39m
    [31m          area.add(`${hoveredTarget.q},${hoveredTarget.r}`);[39m
    [31m          area.add(`${charPos.q},${charPos.r}`);[39m
    [31m        }[39m
    [31m        break;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      case 'CREATE_GATE': {[39m
    [31m        area.add(`${hoveredTarget.q},${hoveredTarget.r}`);[39m
    [31m        break;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      case 'CREATE_FORMATION': {[39m
    [31m        const hexes = hexSpiral(hoveredTarget.q, hoveredTarget.r, 1);[39m
    [31m        for (const [q, r] of hexes) area.add(`${q},${r}`);[39m
    [31m        break;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      case 'APPLY_STATUS': {[39m
    [31m        if (eff.status === 'METEOR_ASCENDING') {[39m
    [31m          const hexes = hexSpiral(hoveredTarget.q, hoveredTarget.r, 1);[39m
    [31m          for (const [q, r] of hexes) area.add(`${q},${r}`);[39m
    [31m        }[39m
    [31m        break;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m    }[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  return [...area].map(k => { const [q, r] = k.split(',').map(Number); return { q, r }; });[39m
    [31m}[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31mfunction getCharactersAtHex(q, r) {[39m
    [31m  return engine.getState().characters.filter(c =>[39m
    [31m    c.alive !== false && c.position?.q === q && c.position?.r === r[39m
    [31m  );[39m
    [31m}[39m
    [31mfunction getCharacterAtHex(q, r) {[39m
    [31m  const chars = getCharactersAtHex(q, r);[39m
    [31m  return chars[0] || null;[39m
    [31m}[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m// --- Canvas click ---[39m
    [31mcanvas.addEventListener('click', (e) => {[39m
    [31m  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();[39m
    [31m  const mx = e.clientX - rect.left, my = e.clientY - rect.top;[39m
    [31m  const [hq, hr] = pixelToHex(mx, my);[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  if (!isOnBoard(hq, hr)) return;[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  const clickedChar = getCharacterAtHex(hq, hr);[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Galaxy sub-phase target selection (panel hidden, waiting for hex click)[39m
    [31m  if (battleSession.galaxyActive && battleSession.galaxySelectedSkill && !document.getElementById('galaxy-overlay').classList.contains('show')) {[39m
    [31m    const skill = SKILLS[battleSession.galaxySelectedSkill];[39m
    [31m    if (skill && skill.targeting.shape !== 'SELF' && skill.targeting.shape !== 'AOE_SELF') {[39m
    [31m      engine.submitGalaxyAction(battleSession.galaxySelectedSkill, { q: hq, r: hr });[39m
    [31m      if (networkManager && networkManager.mode !== 'local') {[39m
    [31m        networkManager.sendGalaxyAction(battleSession.galaxyCharId, battleSession.galaxySelectedSkill, { q: hq, r: hr });[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      battleSession.galaxySelectedSkill = null;[39m
    [31m      battleSession.validTargets = [];[39m
    [31m      battleSession.hoverEffectArea = [];[39m
    [31m      battleSession.hoveredHex = null;[39m
    [31m      document.getElementById('submit-status').textContent = '等待双方提交...';[39m
    [31m      return;[39m
    [31m    }[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // If only viewing opponent skill, clicking a hex clears the view[39m
    [31m  if (battleSession.viewingSkill && !battleSession.selectedSkill) {[39m
    [31m    battleSession.viewingSkill = null;[39m
    [31m    battleSession.validTargets = [];[39m
    [31m    battleSession.hoverEffectArea = [];[39m
    [31m    battleSession.hoveredHex = null;[39m
    [31m    if (clickedChar) battleSession.selectedCharacterId = clickedChar.id;[39m
    [31m    renderAll();[39m
    [31m    return;[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  if (!battleSession.selectedSkill) {[39m
    [31m    if (clickedChar) {[39m
    [31m      // Cycle through chars on same hex on repeated clicks[39m
    [31m      const hexChars = getCharactersAtHex(hq, hr);[39m
    [31m      if (hexChars.length > 1 && hexChars.some(c => c.id === battleSession.selectedCharacterId)) {[39m
    [31m        const curIdx = hexChars.findIndex(c => c.id === battleSession.selectedCharacterId);[39m
    [31m        const next = hexChars[(curIdx + 1) % hexChars.length];[39m
    [31m        battleSession.selectedCharacterId = next.id;[39m
    [31m        battleSession.lastHoveredCharacterId = next.id;[39m
    [31m      } else {[39m
    [31m        battleSession.selectedCharacterId = clickedChar.id;[39m
    [31m        battleSession.lastHoveredCharacterId = clickedChar.id;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      renderAll();[39m
    [31m    }[39m
    [31m    return;[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  const charId = battleSession.selectedSkill.charId;[39m
    [31m  const skill = SKILLS[battleSession.selectedSkill.skillId];[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  if (skill.targeting.shape === 'SELF' || skill.targeting.shape === 'AOE_SELF') {[39m
    [31m    battleSession.submitAction(charId, battleSession.selectedSkill.skillId, null);[39m
    [31m    return;[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  // Click on invalid hex cancels selection[39m
    [31m  if (!battleSession.validTargets.some(t => t.q === hq && t.r === hr)) {[39m
    [31m    battleSession.selectedSkill = null;[39m
    [31m    battleSession.validTargets = [];[39m
    [31m    battleSession.hoverEffectArea = [];[39m
    [31m    battleSession.hoveredHex = null;[39m
    [31m    renderAll();[39m
    [31m    return;[39m
    [31m  }[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m  battleSession.submitAction(charId, battleSession.selectedSkill.skillId, { q: hq, r: hr });[39m
    [31m});[39m
    [31m[39m
    [31m// [moved to BattleSessionController] battleSession.submitAction[39m

    [31m  if (networkManager && networkManager.mode !== 'local') {[39m

    [31m  if (isPveMode()) {[39m

    [31m});[39m

    [31m  if (battleConfigs) {[39m
    [31m    startBattleFromConfigs(Date.now(), battleConfigs);[39m
